args.title: Document field limits for the Reports API
args.body:
File: docs/API.md

The Reports section doesn't state the validation limits enforced by src/api/reports.ts: `name` is at most 120 characters, `categories` has at most 50 entries (each at most 60 characters), and `schedule.recipients` has at most 20 email addresses (at least 1). Add these limits to the Reports section (near the `POST /reports` and `schedule` descriptions) so API consumers can validate client-side before sending.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The limits are real and enforced in src/api/reports.ts: `name` max 120 chars, `categories` max 50 entries (each max 60 chars), and `schedule.recipients` between 1 and 20 email addresses. The Reports section of docs/API.md should list these alongside the field descriptions for `POST /reports` and `schedule` so clients can validate before sending.
